goal:
Implement only src/actions.ts, a real reusable part of Skyra E2E's Playwright runner. Export async executeStep(page: Page, target: Target, step: Step, timeoutMs: number): Promise<void>. Import types from playwright, ./types.ts and ./contracts.ts. The orchestrator validates target/pack before using this helper and owns browser contexts, network routing, cancellation, screenshots, traces and final error redaction. This helper must not launch/close browsers/pages, route requests, install dependencies, write files or run commands. It must reject invalid integer timeouts outside 1..30000 and unexpected runtime action variants.
Implement goto/fill/click/expectVisible/expectText using real supported Playwright methods. Use getByRole(value,{name,exact:true}), getByLabel(value,{exact:true}), getByText(value,{exact:true}), getByTestId(value). Reuse one locator helper. goto resolves step.path against target.baseUrl, rejects non-http(s) or different-origin URLs BEFORE calling page.goto, and rejects missing response/HTTP status >=400. Require final page URL to have the same origin. This is not a standalone SSRF guard; orchestrator will block cross-origin network before effects.
Pass bounded timeout options to every browser action/wait/text read. expectText first requires visibility and then polls until textContent includes step.value as a case-sensitive substring. Use one deadline for the whole step so visibility wait plus polling/read cannot independently consume full budgets. Delayed text must succeed. Missing/wrong-case text must reject on time. Do not use arbitrary page.evaluate scripts or Playwright test-runner dependency. Do not close a page on action failure: the orchestrator needs it for evidence. Do not swallow errors or invent success. No any, unsafe assertions, duplicate validation helpers, protected file edits or claims tests passed. Keep implementation concise with reusable functions.
The previous whole-runner task was withheld after review (unsupported route.resume, unsafe indices, poor timeout classification, swallowed cleanup errors). This smaller task is the action component only; do not recreate the orchestrator. Supplied tests use real Chromium, delayed UI text and failure paths.
